name: www.wattscope.com.au
description: WattScope helps teams see the carbon cost of the AI they are already using. Ask Claude to  record a piece of work and it attributes the estimated footprint to your organization and to  a project, then reports it back — per session, per project, or organization-wide. Every figure is an estimate, and carries the strength of the evidence behind it.

_published_faq.name: How do I add www.wattscope.com.au to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add www.wattscope.com.au to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://www.wattscope.com.au/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the www.wattscope.com.au MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: www.wattscope.com.au provides these MCP tools: get_offset_options, get_project_footprint, get_session_footprint, list_projects, org_footprint, record_chat_estimate, record_usage, server_info, set_active_org, set_project, and start_session.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to www.wattscope.com.au?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to www.wattscope.com.au in other on the Manufact MCP catalog include Muju, ZMAXINC, PGA – Play Golf, citytracker.ai, and Commonlands Optics: M12 Lens and C-Mount Lens Finder + Field-of-View Calculator.
www.wattscope.com.au requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
